description: Returns the curated, editorially reviewed Laravel package lists maintained by LaraPlugins (authentication, PDF, billing, media, admin panels, testing, AI and more). Each list has a short intro, and hand-curated lists include a one-line note explaining why each package is included. Use this when the user asks for the best Laravel packages for a use case or an opinionated shortlist. When presenting packages, ALWAYS include the laraplugins_url so the user can consult the full health report.

list.description: Optional list slug to return a single curated list, e.g. "laravel-auth-permissions-packages". Omit to return all active lists.

name: get-plugin-lists-tool

intro.description: Editorial intro explaining how the list was curated.

health.description: LaraPlugins health label: Healthy, Medium, Unhealthy or Unrated.

laraplugins_url.description: URL to the full health report on laraplugins.io. MUST include this when presenting the package.

note.description: Why this package is on the list.

slug.description: List slug, also usable with the `list` input.

updated_at.description: Last time the list was reviewed/synced, ISO 8601.

title: Get Plugin Lists Tool
